author: VitalikButerin
text:
Screenshots of the Philip Morris website.

(reminder: they're a leading cigarette company)

It's a good calibration point for how good modern marketing is at dressing up pretty much any corporate (or, for that matter, government) behavior and making it sound responsible and safe.
